title: Get Creative Features Request
description: Request payload for the get_creative_features task. Submits a creative manifest for evaluation by a governance agent, which analyzes the creative and returns scored feature values (brand safety, content categorization, quality metrics, etc.). Although named like a read, this operation creates a provider-side evaluation and may record consumption or cost, so it is replay-protected and economically consequential.
x-tool-summary: Evaluate a creative manifest and return scored safety, content, quality, and governance features.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key for this evaluation. Exact retries with the same canonical payload return the cached initial response with replayed: true and do not dispatch a second provider evaluation or record a second consumption or cost event. Reusing the key with a different creative_manifest, account, or feature_ids payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The provider MUST retain the replay record for at least 24 hours. MUST be unique per (provider, request) pair to prevent cross-provider correlation. Use a fresh UUID v4 for each logical evaluation.

creative_manifest.description: The canonical creative manifest to evaluate. In 3.2 it contains `format_kind`, optional `format_option_ref`, and typed assets. The deprecated named `format_id` branch remains available only for older 3.x peers.

feature_ids.description: Optional filter to specific features. If omitted, returns all available features.

account.description: Account for billing this evaluation. Required when the governance agent charges per evaluation.

push_notification_config.description: Optional webhook configuration for async terminal completion/failure notifications. A submitted acknowledgement remains pollable through get_task_status whether or not this field is present. If the provider accepts this field and returns status: submitted, it MUST deliver at least the terminal completion or failure notification to the configured URL. If it cannot honor the webhook channel, it MUST reject the request instead of silently downgrading delivery.
